question: What is the narrowest sound multi-step meaning justified by the green DefinitionOpeningPath challenge without importing equality, generic transitivity, normalization, or hidden proof-DAG semantics?

models.name: opening-path-as-equality-transitivity
models.reason: a:b and b:c establish two definition-opening facts, not a=c, equivalence, substitution, or normalization

models.name: opening-path-as-search-trace-only
models.reason: the challenged path has independently replayable semantics and therefore is stronger than an untrusted search trace

models.name: opening-path-as-operational-composite-certificate
models.reason: its complete meaning is exactly a finite ordered sequence of successful canonical open_definition replays under one explicit environment and lookup scope, plus structural adjacency and finite-cycle canonicality

models.name: generic-proof-composition-from-opening-path
models.reason: one sound composite certificate does not justify symmetry, transitivity, congruence, modus ponens, global substitution, or arbitrary proof-DAG composition

preferredCandidate.meaning: the exact serialized finite edge sequence independently replays as successful open_definition steps in one explicit lexical environment/lookup scope and every adjacent target matches the previous replayed body structurally

artifactDecision.reason: self-contained substrate preserves portable independent replay and does not introduce general proof-DAG dependency semantics prematurely

edgeDecision.targetIdentity: typed structural Form identity after parsing; equivalent whitespace allowed
edgeDecision.bodyTransport: exact canonical format_expression of independently replayed Definition.value
edgeDecision.bodyIdentityForAdjacency: typed structural identity after parsing replayed body and next target

cycleDecision.mutualCycleCanonicalWitness: one edge per distinct DefinitionId until the target repeats
cycleDecision.reason: the artifact is a finite simple opening path; rejection of repeated DefinitionId prevents infinite-unfold encodings without denying recursive definitions

compositionWithContextualSatisfaction.futureCandidate: a separately challenged operational relation may serialize both a verified opening path and an explicit ContextuallySatisfies replay of its terminal body

nextGate.goal: publish a standalone accepted operational certificate contract, canonical production verifier, and language-neutral conformance before proof-v0.4 consumes the relation
